name: MonarchAutosaveIndicator
title: AutosaveIndicator
summary: Saves a value automatically after the person stops changing it (debounced, one save at a time, retried, flushable) and shows where saving stands.
whenToUse: For drafts and settings that save without a Save button: notes, descriptions, document content, preferences edited in place.
whenNotToUse: When people must confirm before anything is stored, use a Save button with MonarchFormActionsBar. To show a status your own code computes, use MonarchSaveStatusIndicator directly.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAutosaveIndicator(state: MonarchAutosaveState<*>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, announceSaving: Boolean = false, errorMessage: ((Throwable) -> String)? = null, icon: (@Composable (MonarchSaveStatus) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSaveStatusIndicatorLabels = MonarchSaveStatusIndicatorLabels())

class MonarchAutosaveState<T>(initialValue: T, scope: CoroutineScope, onSave: suspend (T) -> Unit, delayMillis: Long = 1000L, retries: Int = 2, retryDelayMillis: Long = 2000L, initialSavedAt: Long? = null, isEqual: (T, T) -> Boolean = { a, b -> a == b }, clock: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis) { var onSave: suspend (T) -> Unit; val status: MonarchSaveStatus; val savedAt: Long?; val error: Throwable?; val dirty: Boolean; val value: T; var enabled: Boolean; fun update(value: T); fun retry(); suspend fun flush(): Boolean }

@Composable fun <T> rememberMonarchAutosaveState(value: T, onSave: suspend (T) -> Unit, enabled: Boolean = true, delayMillis: Long = 1000L, retries: Int = 2, retryDelayMillis: Long = 2000L, initialSavedAt: Long? = null, isEqual: (T, T) -> Boolean = { a, b -> a == b }): MonarchAutosaveState<T>

options.name: state
options.description: The autosave state, from rememberMonarchAutosaveState or created in a ViewModel with viewModelScope.

options.name: announceSaving
options.description: Also announces "Saving…". Saved and the error are always announced.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Turns the failure into the visible message. null shows "Couldn't save".

options.name: icon
options.description: Replaces the status dot, as in MonarchSaveStatusIndicator.

options.name: MonarchAutosaveState.onSave
options.description: Stores a value. Suspend until it is stored; throw to report a failure.

options.name: MonarchAutosaveState.delayMillis
options.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last change before saving.

options.name: MonarchAutosaveState.retries
options.description: Automatic retries after a failed save before the status becomes Error.

options.name: MonarchAutosaveState.retryDelayMillis
options.description: Milliseconds before the first automatic retry; doubled for each further one.

options.name: MonarchAutosaveState.initialSavedAt
options.description: When the first value was last saved, in epoch milliseconds (UTC). Starts the status at Saved with the time.

options.name: MonarchAutosaveState.isEqual
options.description: Decides whether two values are the same, so an equal value is not saved again.

options.name: MonarchAutosaveState.clock
options.description: The current time for savedAt. Replace it in tests.

options.name: MonarchAutosaveState.enabled
options.description: While false, changes only mark the value unsaved; flush and retry still save.

states.name: idle
states.description: Nothing changed since the start and no save time is known: nothing is drawn.

states.name: unsaved
states.description: A change waits for the delay, or saving is disabled: "Unsaved changes".

states.name: saving
states.description: A save runs, or an automatic retry waits: a small progress ring and "Saving…".

states.name: error
states.description: The retries are used up: "Couldn't save" (or errorMessage) and a Retry button; announced.

appearance: Exactly MonarchSaveStatusIndicator: a dot or progress ring in the status color, caption text in muted or danger colors by role, and a ghost Retry button. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web splits this into a useAutosave hook and an AutosaveIndicator; on Android the hook is MonarchAutosaveState (a state holder on coroutines that can live in a ViewModel) with rememberMonarchAutosaveState for screens, and the indicator takes the state. The web compares values with Object.is then JSON; Android uses == (data classes compare by content) or isEqual. The web flush returns a promise; on Android it is a suspend function. Dates are epoch milliseconds. iOS has no entry yet; the names follow the web.
accessibility: The status is read as one element, "Saved, 2 minutes ago", from MonarchSaveStatusIndicator.
Saved and the error are announced through a polite live region; Saving only with announceSaving, so frequent autosaves stay quiet.
Retry is a MonarchButton with a 48dp touch target.
The status is always written in words; color is never the only signal.
edgeCases: An edit during a save is saved after it, once the delay has passed again; two saves never overlap.
Changing the value back to the saved one cancels the pending save.
During automatic retries the status stays Saving; only after the last retry it becomes Error.
rememberMonarchAutosaveState stops when it leaves the composition: call flush before navigating away, or keep the state in a ViewModel.
delayMillis, retries, retryDelayMillis and isEqual are read once when the state is created.
